items.title: Strategy buys $142.7M worth of bitcoin
items.summary: Scott Melker discusses Strategy (MSTR) buying more bitcoin (BTC-USD) this week, bitcoin ETFs recording $2.4 billion in net inflows last week, the strongest demand for ETFs since October 2025, and Bitget becoming the last victim of a hack where $350 million disappeared from users' wallets.
